_comment: Invite templates for self-registration. Each invite is an access-rights template: agents present `code` via the `register` frame and the relay mints a persona with what the invite grants. Grants are guild-scoped: `guildId` names the guild, and `grant.scope` is {channels:[...]}, {mirrorRole}, {mirrorRoles:[...]} or {all:true} (every channel of that guild); or use `roles` (access roles from the catalog). Bound by optional maxUses and/or expiresAt. `uses` is maintained by the relay. Generate codes with: node scripts/mint-invite.mjs (see --help).
